ideas.name: Recurring On-Chain Report Agent
ideas.deliverable: A scheduled agent that pulls a supplied set of DEX pools or wallet addresses via read-only public APIs and posts a formatted volume/treasury report on a fixed cadence.
ideas.buyer: Small DeFi teams and independent traders who currently pull this data by hand.

evidence.label: observed
evidence.note: Job post explicitly requests a daily DEX volume summary bot, states a $200 budget.

evidence.label: observed
evidence.note: Support ticket records a customer request for an automatic weekly treasury summary instead of manual CSV pulls.

evidence.label: inference
evidence.note: Manual spreadsheet-copying pain from a payments dashboard suggests the same recurring-report pattern applies beyond DeFi.

evidence.label: unverified_demand
evidence.note: The $200 budget is a posted figure, not a completed payment.

limitations: Needs read-only API access or public endpoints supplied by the buyer; no custody of funds or keys.
Report generation only — no trading signals or advice.
Accuracy depends entirely on the freshness/correctness of the public data source.
ideas.next_validation_step: Post one fixed-price offer ($150-200) scoped to exactly this deliverable on a freelance board or DeFi builder channel; treat 3+ serious replies within a week as validation.

ideas.name: Protocol Parameter-Change Watcher
ideas.deliverable: An agent that checks a supplied list of up to 5 protocol doc URLs on a schedule and outputs a plain-text diff of what changed since the last check.
ideas.buyer: Crypto newsletter writers and independent researchers who track multiple protocols.

evidence.label: observed
evidence.note: Post states manually checking 15 protocol docs weekly before writing a newsletter, asks for an agent to do it.

evidence.label: inference
evidence.note: Same 'manual repeated checking of external sources' pattern as the sanctions-flagging request, suggesting watcher-style agents are a recurring category.

evidence.label: unverified_demand
evidence.note: Only one source expresses this want; no confirmed willingness to pay stated.

limitations: Only works reliably on pages with stable, diffable structure; heavy redesigns cause false positives.
Doesn't interpret whether a change is material, only that text changed.
Bounded to 5 doc URLs per run by the skill's own source policy.
ideas.next_validation_step: Run the watcher against 3 real protocol docs for 2 weeks and count false-positive diffs before offering it to anyone.

ideas.name: Wallet Hop-Distance Flagging Agent
ideas.deliverable: An agent that takes a supplied wallet list and a public sanctions list, then outputs a CSV flagging wallets within N hops of a sanctioned address, using public chain data only.
ideas.buyer: Compliance-adjacent teams at small exchanges or protocols who currently do this by hand.

evidence.label: observed
evidence.note: GitHub issue explicitly requests auto-flagging of wallets within 2 hops of sanctioned addresses, notes current manual spreadsheet process.

limitations: Single source of evidence — weakest-supported idea of the three.
Accuracy bounded by the currency of whatever public sanctions list is supplied; not legal or compliance advice.
Hop-distance heuristic will miss laundering patterns that don't fit simple N-hop graphs.
ideas.next_validation_step: Run the agent against one publicly known sanctioned test wallet and manually confirm it correctly flags 1- and 2-hop counterparties before showing it to anyone.
